title: listCatalogEngagements request
description: listCatalogEngagements - request. Paginated enumeration of a firm's engagements from the Engagements System catalog (declared assumption SUP-08: if it does not exist, SX-04 disappears).
$comment: Source: DISENO S5 (b) CatalogCursor, (d) EngagementCatalogPort (ACL), (e) paginated catalog read; DISENO 4.8 SX-04; ADR-020 SX-04 + SUP-08 (catalog lists id, firm, template, version without loading engagements). Audience: CONSUMED CONTRACT (external system, client-side expectation) - SX-04 (S5 -> external catalog). Residency: REGIONAL (cell). Idempotency: safe read. Pagination: CatalogCursor (opaque, owned by the external system). CONSUMED CONTRACT: owned by an external team; method, path, authentication and error bodies are NOT defined by the documents and are not designed here. Fallback: pause the saga. Rate limit agreed with the owning team.

headers.description: Headers the client propagates when the transport allows it.
